# Proposed contract v1 fixtures

These files are synthetic examples for the requested upstream integration
contract. No released irlume version emits them.

The examples specify required semantics, not immutable naming. If upstream
publishes a reviewed contract with different names, these fixtures must be
replaced by sanitized outputs from that official release before any engine
version is enabled.

All identifiers and checksums are deterministic placeholders. They do not
identify a real account, device, profile, transaction, or host.
